title: Assembly of Homochiral Magneto-Optical Dy6 Triangular Clusters by Fixing Carbon Dioxide in the Air

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of H2L_Schiff (0.25 mmol), L-proline (0.25 mmol), Dy(CF3SO3)3 (0.25 mmol), and LiOH·H2O (0.75 mmol) in 5 mL of DMA was stirred for 24 h to form a brownish-red solution, which was filtered and transferred to a beaker. Slow evaporation of the solvent afforded red single crystals of L-1 after a few weeks. Atmospheric CO2 was fixed as a central carbonato bridge during assembly. Yield about 20% based on Dy.
synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystals after a few weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring in DMA followed by filtration into a beaker and slow solvent evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered brownish-red solution; slow evaporation yielded red single crystals

properties.summary: L-1 shows intramolecular ferromagnetic Dy···Dy coupling, magnetic anisotropy, and slow magnetic relaxation with a small effective barrier (Ueff/k ≈ 6.5–8.3 K). Frequency-dependent AC χ″ appears below ~5 K without peaks even under 2000 Oe DC. The enantiomer pair exhibits a magneto-optical Faraday effect (|g_max(MCD)| = 0.026 T−1 for L-1) and SHG intensity equal to KDP (1.0 × KDP) at room temperature; no THG was observed.

Section 3.4 Syntheses of L-1 and D-1

synthesis.procedure: Prepared analogously to L-1: a mixture of H2L_Schiff (0.25 mmol), D-proline (0.25 mmol), Dy(CF3SO3)3 (0.25 mmol), and LiOH·H2O (0.75 mmol) in 5 mL of DMA was stirred for 24 h to form a brownish-red solution, which was filtered and transferred to a beaker. Slow evaporation afforded red single crystals of D-1 after a few weeks. Atmospheric CO2 was fixed as a central carbonato bridge. Yield about 20% based on Dy.
synthesis.time: stirred 24 h; crystals after a few weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirring in DMA followed by filtration into a beaker and slow solvent evaporation in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered brownish-red solution; slow evaporation yielded red single crystals

properties.summary: D-1 is the enantiomer of L-1 and is treated as magnetically equivalent; the pair shows intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling and magnetic relaxation. Optically, D-1 displays CD/MCD spectra that are mirror-symmetric to L-1, a Faraday effect with |g_max(MCD)| = 0.027 T−1 at room temperature, and an SHG response of 1.0 × KDP.
